onboarding.title: About you
onboarding.intro: Tell clients who you are and where you work. You can change this later in the profile.

work.onlineHint: New orders will come here. Tap to stop.
work.locationDenied: Masterio Pro needs your location to offer you nearby orders and show clients where you are.
work.backgroundDenied: Allow location "Always" so orders and tracking work when the app is in the background.
work.activeOrderHint: Tap to open the order, navigation and chat.
work.waitingHint: When a client nearby needs help, you will get an offer with a timer. Keep your phone at hand.

offer.title: New order
offer.unavailable: The order is no longer available.

order.title: Order
order.arriveHint: "I've arrived" works only when you are at the address.
order.estimateNone: No estimate yet. Agree on the price with the client and send it here.
order.estimateChangeHint: A new estimate replaces the old one only after the client approves it.
order.commissionNote: The platform commission is calculated from the approved estimate and charged from your balance.
order.completeConfirmBody: You confirm that you received {{amount}} in cash. The client will be asked to confirm the same amount.
order.debtNote: Not enough balance: {{amount}} became debt. Top up to keep receiving orders.
order.waitingClient: Waiting for the client to confirm the payment.
order.cancelWarning: Cancelling after accepting lowers your rating and position in the queue. Frequent cancellations lead to a block.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.hint: List the work and materials. The client approves the estimate in the app; only then the amount counts.
estimate.fillAll: Fill in the description, quantity and price for every line.

history.noTier: No bonus tier yet this month.
history.bonusConditions: Conditions: rating from {{rating}}, cancellations up to {{cancel}}%, no lost disputes.
history.bonusFormula: The bonus is a share of the commission you paid. It is not money: it reduces the platform commission on new orders next month and then expires.

wallet.debtHint: You have a debt to the platform. New orders will come after you top up.
wallet.order: Clients pay you in cash. After each order the platform commission is charged from your balance in this order: bonus (up to half of the commission), welcome credit, top-up. If the balance is not enough, the rest becomes debt.

topup.title: Top up
topup.hint: The balance is used to receive orders and to pay the platform commission.
topup.terms: A top-up is a prepayment for platform services. It cannot be withdrawn; the remainder is returned when you close the account, minus debts.
topup.success: Payment accepted. The balance will update within a minute.

documents.title: Documents
documents.privacy: Documents are stored in a closed storage. Only you and authorised Masterio staff can see them; every view is logged.
documents.idHint: Passport or ID card. The photo must be sharp, all text readable.
documents.selfieHint: Take a photo of your face in good light, without glasses or a hat.
documents.licensesHint: Some services require a license. Choose a service to upload its license.
documents.licenseHint: Photo or scan of the valid license for the chosen service.
documents.permissionDenied: Allow access to the camera or photos in the phone settings.
documents.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.

profile.radiusHint: You can reduce the distance to orders, but not above the platform limit.
profile.autoEarningsHint: Used for card orders, when they are available in your city.
profile.platformNote: Masterio connects clients and independent professionals; the work is performed and guaranteed by the professional.

tracking.onlineBody: Your location is used to offer you nearby orders.
tracking.activeBody: The client sees where you are until the order is completed.

permissions.location: Masterio Pro uses your location to offer you nearby orders and to show the client where you are during an active order.
permissions.locationAlways: Allow "Always" so orders and live tracking keep working when Masterio Pro is in the background. Location is shared with the client only during an active order.
permissions.camera: Masterio Pro uses the camera to photograph your documents, selfie and work results.
permissions.photos: Masterio Pro needs access to photos to upload your documents.

team.title: My team
team.legalNote: Masterio is not the employer or insurer of team members. The leader or company is responsible for helpers as required by law.
team.disabled: Teams are not available in your country.
team.createText: Create a team, invite helpers or employees and send them to orders. Commission, balance and rating stay on your account.
team.name: Team name
team.capacity: You can take {{count}} orders at the same time.
team.noMembers: No members yet. Invite someone by phone number.
team.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They will be able to work on their own.
team.notAssignable: Cannot be assigned until the identity is confirmed.
team.inviteText: The person installs Masterio Pro, signs in with this number and accepts the invitation. Then they upload documents for the identity check.
team.consentNeeded: Before adding helpers, accept the terms for teams.
team.inviteSentExisting: Invitation sent. The person will see it in Masterio Pro.
team.inviteSentNew: Invitation saved. Ask the person to install Masterio Pro and sign in with this number.
team.memberRules: In a team you get orders only from your leader: no going online, no wallet. Commission, rating and cancellations belong to the leader.
team.leaveConfirm: After leaving you can work on your own with your categories and cities.
team.invitesText: Accept to work as a team member, or continue on your own.
team.memberOnboarding: You joined «{{team}}». Enter your name — the client sees it — and upload documents for the identity check.
team.memberKyc: Your leader can send you to orders after the identity check.
team.memberActiveHint: Open it: address, route and status buttons. Your location is shared with the client while you work.
team.noAssignmentsHint: When your leader sends you to an order, you will get a notification.
team.teamOrders: Team members are on {{count}} orders (up to {{capacity}} at once)
team.assignNeeded: Choose a team member before {{time}}, otherwise you go yourself.
team.autoAssigned: Assigned automatically: the time to choose ran out.
team.performerConfirms: Statuses, the estimate and completion are confirmed from the performer's phone.
team.pendingChange: Waiting for the client to agree to {{name}}.
team.consentHint: The client must agree to the replacement; until then the current performer stays.
team.notifyHint: The client will be notified about the new performer.
team.memberOrderNote: Cancellation and disputes on this order are handled by your leader.

roleHint.MASTER: A second master who works independently on orders you assign.
roleHint.HELPER: A helper who goes to orders and works under your responsibility.
roleHint.EMPLOYEE: An employee of your company; the company policy can cover them.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: What should the professional call you?
onboarding.platformNote: Masterio connects you with independent professionals. The service is provided by the professional.

home.subtitle: What happened? Choose a service — we will find a professional nearby.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.urgentHint: Urgent service: we offer the order to the nearest available professionals first.
newOrder.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: the car will not start, the battery is dead
newOrder.photos: Photos help the professional understand the problem (optional). Long-press a photo to remove it.
newOrder.permissionDenied: No access to the camera or photos. Allow it in the phone settings.
newOrder.tooLarge: The photo is too large (max 10 MB).
newOrder.noneNearby: No free professionals right now. You can still place the order — we will keep searching.
newOrder.noneNearbyFar: No professionals nearby, but there are some further away. After ordering you can expand the search radius.
newOrder.cashWarning: Pay only the amount from the estimate in the app. Do not agree to pay outside the app — such orders are not protected.
newOrder.legal: The price is agreed with the professional on site and approved by you in the app before work starts.

address.title: Address
address.dragHint: Move the map so the pin points exactly at the place.
address.label: Name
address.permissionDenied: No access to location. Allow it in the phone settings or find the address by search.

addresses.title: My addresses
addresses.empty: No saved addresses yet. You can save one when placing an order.

order.title: Order
order.searchingText: We offer your order to professionals one by one, nearest first, within {{distance}}.
order.noWorkersTitle: No professional accepted the order yet
order.noWorkersText: You can expand the search radius, search again or cancel.
order.arrived: The professional has arrived. Agree on the work and the price — the estimate will appear here.
order.inProgress: Work in progress. If the price changes, you will be asked to approve a new estimate.
order.disputed: The amounts did not match, so a dispute was opened. Support will contact you. Do not pay anything extra outside the app.
order.platformNote: Masterio is a platform: the service is provided by an independent professional. The platform does not insure the work.

track.connectionLost: Connection with the professional is lost — showing the last known position.
track.recenter: Show the professional and the address

estimate.hint: The professional starts work only after your approval.

payment.title: Confirm the payment
payment.paid: How much did you pay in cash? ({{currency}})
payment.invalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 45.50.
payment.mismatchBody: You entered {{amount}}, the professional entered {{reported}}. A dispute will be opened and support will review it.
payment.hint: If the professional did not finish the work or asks for more money, enter what you actually paid — we will sort it out.

blacklist.block: Do not offer my orders to this professional
blacklist.unblock: Offer my orders to this professional again
blacklist.blockedHint: This professional will not receive your new orders.

cancel.title: Why are you cancelling?
cancel.fee: Cancellation fee: {{amount}} — compensation for the professional’s travel.
cancel.reportHint: Thank you for telling us. Support will check this professional; you are not charged.

profile.safetyText: Every professional passes ID verification. Pay only the amount approved in the app, keep all communication in the in-app chat, and report any request to pay outside the app.

permissions.location: Masterio uses your location to fill in the address where help is needed and to find professionals nearby.
permissions.camera: Masterio uses the camera so you can photograph the problem for the professional.
permissions.photos: Masterio needs access to photos so you can attach pictures of the problem to the order.

legal.title: Please review the terms
legal.intro: To continue, read and accept the current documents. We store which version you accepted and when.
legal.agree: I have read and accept these documents
legal.topupNeeded: Before topping up, accept the balance top-up terms.

reason.CLIENT_NO_SHOW: Client was not at the address

status.AWAITING_RESPONSE: Waiting for the other side to respond
status.UNRESOLVED_REFERRED: Not resolved — see where to turn next

resolution.in_favor_client: Decided in favour of the client
resolution.in_favor_worker: Decided in favour of the worker
resolution.partial: Partly in favour of each side

dispute.title: Dispute
dispute.newIntro: Describe what went wrong. Support will see the chat, the order history and the photos, and will ask the other side for an explanation.
dispute.injuryHint: If someone is hurt or in danger, call the emergency number first.
dispute.descriptionHint: What exactly is wrong, and what outcome do you expect?
dispute.howItWorks: The other side gets a set time to answer. Support then reviews everything and proposes a solution. Opening a dispute does not stop you from contacting each other.
dispute.nextSteps: We could not reach an agreement inside the platform. You can contact a consumer protection organisation, a mediation service or a court in your country. All materials of this dispute stay saved and can be exported in Privacy.
dispute.notCourt: Support helps the parties reach an agreement. It is not a court, and its proposal does not replace a court decision.

noShow.title: Client not here
noShow.intro: If you waited at the address and the client did not come out or answer, report it here. The order will go to support.
noShow.rules: You must be at the address, have waited the required time and take a photo of the entrance or door. Your location is checked.
noShow.tooEarly: Please wait {{minutes}} more min at the address.

photos.hint: Up to {{max}} photos. Long-press a photo to remove it.
photos.permission: Allow access in the phone settings to add a photo.

incident.title: Incident
incident.emergencyText: If someone is hurt, there is a fire, gas, water or electrical danger — call the emergency service right now. Masterio is not an emergency service.
incident.notify: After that, report the incident here so support knows about it.
incident.called: I have already called the emergency service
incident.noPromise: Masterio records the incident and helps with communication. The platform does not provide insurance and does not promise compensation.
incident.savedText: Support has received the report and will reply in the ticket.

support.title: Support
support.newIntro: Describe the question. For a problem with an order, it is better to open a dispute from the order screen.
support.subject: Subject

privacy.title: My data
privacy.exportText: We will prepare a file with your profile, orders, messages, payments and consents. The link is valid for a limited time.
privacy.deleteText: Your personal data will be removed. Records we must keep by law (payments, ledger, disputes and their evidence) stay stored without your name and contacts for the required period.
privacy.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete the account?

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.notRequired: Your services and cities do not require insurance right now.
insurance.missing: policy needed — no orders until it is checked
insurance.disclaimer: Masterio checks that the policy exists and is valid but does not insure you and does not guarantee that a particular case is covered — that is decided by your insurer.
insurance.coveredRisks: Covered risks, comma-separated (as in the policy)
insurance.badDate: Check the dates: use DD.MM.YYYY, end after start.

bonus.note: Bonuses only reduce future commission. They cannot be withdrawn as money.

team.changeText: The professional asks to send {{name}} ({{role}}) instead.
team.changeHint: This person passed the identity check. If you decline, the current performer stays; if you disagree, contact support.
team.mismatchTitle: Not the person from the app?
team.mismatchHint: The app says {{name}} should come. If someone else came, do not let them start — we will open a dispute and support will contact you.
team.mismatchConfirm: The order will be stopped and a dispute opened. Continue?
